title.ru: Акценты, скорость и естественная английская речь
title.en: Accents, Speed and Natural Spoken English

description.ru: Развивайте понимание естественной повседневной английской речи уровня C1 по теме «Акценты, скорость и естественная английская речь» и воспроизводите её ритм, тон и скрытый смысл.
description.en: Develop C1 understanding of natural everyday English for accents, speed and natural spoken english and reproduce its rhythm, tone, and implied meaning.

objective.ru: Понимать быструю естественную речь уровня C1 в повседневной ситуации, распознавать тон, идиомы и скрытый смысл и точно воспроизводить связную речь.
objective.en: Understand fast, natural C1 speech in an everyday situation, recognise tone, idioms, and implied meaning, and reproduce connected speech accurately.

instructions.en: Match the English words with their translations.

data.question: Which interpretation best captures what the speaker really means?

options.text: When unfamiliar sounds blur together, focus on each stressed key word and use context clues to reconstruct the overall message.
The speaker means every word literally and expresses no attitude beyond the surface message.
The expressions are unrelated, so tone and context cannot clarify the message.

data.explanation: The correct response preserves the speaker’s everyday meaning, tone, qualification, and implied attitude.
